fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META +6.55%) owns social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp with 3 billion monthly active users and 2 billion daily login users.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta recorded Q3 2026 net income of $9.86 billion, representing 264% growth year-over-year, demonstrating the results of advertising business optimization.
fields.summary_ko.2: Meta is the seventh largest holding in the Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (VTI +4.49%) at 1.86%, with 773 ETFs holding approximately 368.8 million shares.
